_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Recipe For Disaster#000.src: Meet up with Chef Hamsey in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recipe For Disaster#001.src: Ah, bonjour! Welcome to my restaurant, allow me to lead you to your seat-
Recipe For Disaster#001.dst: Ah, bonjour! 제 레스토랑에 오신 걸 환영해요, 자리로 안내해 드리죠-
Recipe For Disaster#001.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#002.src: Oh do my eyes deceive me? Serais-ce possible?!
Recipe For Disaster#002.dst: 어라, 제 눈이 잘못됐나요? Serais-ce possible?!
Recipe For Disaster#002.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#003.src: It is you... the novice soldier turned hero of legends! Who would have thought?!
Recipe For Disaster#003.dst: 당신이군요... 신참 병사에서 전설의 영웅이 된 분! 누가 알았겠어요?!
Recipe For Disaster#003.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#004.src: I have heard tales of your exploits across the lands, mon ami! Je suis honore! Someone like you sitting in my restaurant!
Recipe For Disaster#004.dst: 각지에서 당신의 활약을 들었어요, mon ami! Je suis honore! 당신 같은 분이 제 레스토랑에 앉아 있다니!
Recipe For Disaster#004.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#005.src: Je suis, bien sur... Le Chef Hamsey! Famed across the lands for my flavors, as you are for your weapon!
Recipe For Disaster#005.dst: 그리고 저는, bien sur... Le Chef Hamsey! 당신이 무기로 유명하듯, 저는 맛으로 이름났죠!
Recipe For Disaster#005.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#006.src: I boast, I boast. Je peu t'offrir un plat... but perhaps I have a different proposition for us both.
Recipe For Disaster#006.dst: 자랑이 심했네요. Je peu t'offrir un plat... 하지만 우리 둘을 위한 다른 제안이 있어요.
Recipe For Disaster#006.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#007.src: You may have mastered the art of battle, my friend, but what of... L'Art de la Cuisine?!
Recipe For Disaster#007.dst: 전투의 기술은 통달했겠지만, 친구, 그럼... L'Art de la Cuisine은요?!
Recipe For Disaster#007.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#008.src: Follow me into the kitchen behind me, and I will tell you more.
Recipe For Disaster#008.dst: 제 뒤의 주방으로 따라오세요, 거기서 더 말씀드리죠.
Recipe For Disaster#008.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#009.src: Find Chef Hamsey in his kitchen.

Recipe For Disaster#010.src: Welcome to my kitchen! C'est beau, non?
Recipe For Disaster#010.dst: 제 주방에 어서 오세요! C'est beau, non?
Recipe For Disaster#010.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#011.src: It may be on fire, but... que serais la Cuisine sans une touche de danger, eh?!
Recipe For Disaster#011.dst: 불이 좀 났지만... que serais la Cuisine sans une touche de danger, eh?!
Recipe For Disaster#011.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#012.src: So, back to the challenge. What do you say to a bit of friendly competition, hehe?
Recipe For Disaster#012.dst: 자, 도전 얘기로 돌아가죠. 친선 요리 대결 한판 어때요, 헤헤?
Recipe For Disaster#012.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#013.src: You can work with one of my three best chefs on a dish and present it to me once you're done!
Recipe For Disaster#013.dst: 제 최고의 요리사 셋 중 한 명과 요리를 만들어서 완성되면 저한테 가져오세요!
Recipe For Disaster#013.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#014.src: I, of course, will judge your dish based on the twenty-nine Principes de Cuisine - texture, presentation, originality...
Recipe For Disaster#014.dst: 물론 저는 스물아홉 가지 Principes de Cuisine으로 심사하죠 - 식감, 플레이팅, 독창성...
Recipe For Disaster#014.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#015.src: ... aroma, magical ability... oh, and flavour!
Recipe For Disaster#015.dst: ... 향, 마법적 능력... 아, 그리고 맛!
Recipe For Disaster#015.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#016.src: S'il te plait! Go introduce yourself to each of my chefs and return once you have decided who to work with!
Recipe For Disaster#016.dst: S'il te plait! 요리사들에게 인사하고, 누구와 함께할지 정하면 돌아오세요!
Recipe For Disaster#016.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#017.src: Speak to all three chefs in Hamsey's kitchen.
Recipe For Disaster#017.dst: Hamsey의 주방에 있는 요리사 세 명과 모두 대화하세요.

Recipe For Disaster#018.src: Heya! You must be the adventurer that Hamsey told me about. You know, he was almost ecstatic, but don't tell him I said that!
Recipe For Disaster#018.dst: 안녕하세요! Hamsey가 말한 모험가시죠? 그분 거의 들떠서 난리였어요, 제가 말했다고는 하지 마세요!
Recipe For Disaster#018.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#019.src: Oh, a cook-off? How exciting! I'll gladly help you out. Maybe this way I can prove myself a bit more to the others...?
Recipe For Disaster#019.dst: 어, 요리 대결요? 신난다! 기꺼이 도울게요. 이러면 다른 사람들한테 저를 좀 더 증명할 수 있을지도...?
Recipe For Disaster#019.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#020.src: If we work together, we can make a Seasoned Voidroot Stew, how does that sound?
Recipe For Disaster#020.dst: 같이 하면 Seasoned Voidroot Stew를 만들 수 있어요, 어때요?
Recipe For Disaster#020.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#021.src: You need to talk to the other chefs before deciding what to make, though!
Recipe For Disaster#021.dst: 그래도 뭘 만들지 정하기 전에 다른 요리사들과도 얘기해 보세요!
Recipe For Disaster#021.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#022.src: Good friend of Hamsey's, are you? I'll believe it when - no, if - you somehow win this competition.
Recipe For Disaster#022.dst: Hamsey 절친이라고? 네가 이 대결에서 이기면 - 아니, 이긴다면 - 믿어 주지.
Recipe For Disaster#022.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#023.src: I don't need any amateurs like yourself getting in my way when I'm cooking up a storm!
Recipe For Disaster#023.dst: 한창 요리 솜씨 부릴 때 너 같은 아마추어가 방해하는 건 필요 없어!
Recipe For Disaster#023.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#024.src: Are you still here? Just... go chitchat to someone else, please.
Recipe For Disaster#024.dst: 아직 여기 있어? 그냥... 다른 데 가서 수다 떨어 줘.
Recipe For Disaster#024.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#025.src: Yo, dawg. Name's Frank. Hamsey said you guys go waaay back. Any friend of Hamsey's is good with me, man.
Recipe For Disaster#025.dst: 요, 친구. 난 Frank야. Hamsey가 너희 엄청 오래된 사이래. Hamsey 친구면 나한테도 친구지.
Recipe For Disaster#025.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#026.src: Nothin' too sure on what we're gonna cook yet, figure I'll dream somethin' up before the time comes.
Recipe For Disaster#026.dst: 뭘 요리할지는 아직 잘 모르겠어, 때가 되면 뭐든 떠오르겠지.
Recipe For Disaster#026.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#027.src: Thinkin' a pie, maybe? Not too much effort there, can't go far wrong, right?
Recipe For Disaster#027.dst: 파이는 어때? 손도 별로 안 가고, 크게 망칠 일도 없잖아?
Recipe For Disaster#027.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#028.src: Talk to Hamsey and choose a chef to work with.

Recipe For Disaster#029.src: Ah, you have introduced yourself to tous mes cuisiners? Who do you want to work with?!
Recipe For Disaster#029.dst: Ah, tous mes cuisiners와 인사를 나눴나요? 누구와 함께하고 싶어요?!
Recipe For Disaster#029.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#030.src: Ah, Brie! An excellent chef... and an even better cheese! I jest, I jest. You will work well together, I am certain.
Recipe For Disaster#030.dst: Ah, Brie! 훌륭한 요리사죠... 치즈로는 더 훌륭하고요! 농담이에요, 농담. 분명 잘 맞을 거예요.
Recipe For Disaster#030.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#031.src: Ah, Kale. One of my most talented chefs, though he can be stubborn at times!
Recipe For Disaster#031.dst: Ah, Kale. 가장 재능 있는 요리사 중 하나죠, 가끔 고집이 세지만요!
Recipe For Disaster#031.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#032.src: Frank! Whilst he may seem rather... relaxed, at times, I assure you he is a most capable chef!
Recipe For Disaster#032.dst: Frank! 가끔은 좀... 느긋해 보여도, 정말 유능한 요리사라고 장담해요!
Recipe For Disaster#032.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#033.src: Maitenant, mon ami, head over to your chef and start cooking!
Recipe For Disaster#033.dst: Maitenant, mon ami, 요리사에게 가서 요리를 시작하세요!
Recipe For Disaster#033.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#034.src: Talk to your chosen chef about the dish.

Recipe For Disaster#035.src: Heya again! So you decided to make the Seasoned Voidroot Stew with me? Hurray!
Recipe For Disaster#035.dst: 또 만났네요! 저랑 Seasoned Voidroot Stew를 만들기로 했어요? 만세!
Recipe For Disaster#035.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#036.src: It's not quite as easy as it might seem, but I think together we'll be able to handle it.
Recipe For Disaster#036.dst: 보기만큼 쉽진 않지만, 우리 둘이면 해낼 수 있을 거예요.
Recipe For Disaster#036.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#037.src: Like I said before, about proving myself... I'm the newest chef here at the kitchen and some of the other chefs disapprove of my ideas. This could be my chance!
Recipe For Disaster#037.dst: 아까 말한 증명 얘기요... 제가 이 주방 막내라서, 몇몇 요리사들이 제 아이디어를 안 좋아해요. 이번이 기회일지도 몰라요!
Recipe For Disaster#037.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#038.src: I've been perfecting the recipe for Voidroot Stew for months now and I finally have a chance to show everyone what I'm worth!
Recipe For Disaster#038.dst: Voidroot Stew 레시피를 몇 달째 다듬어 왔는데, 드디어 제 실력을 모두에게 보여 줄 기회예요!
Recipe For Disaster#038.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#039.src: The first one is some [Snail Slime] available on Snail Island! We only need one for this dish.
Recipe For Disaster#039.dst: 첫 번째는 Snail Island에서 구할 수 있는 [Snail Slime]이에요! 이 요리엔 하나면 돼요.
Recipe For Disaster#039.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#040.src: Next up, we need some [Voidroot], a super rare root found deep in the Void. I've heard someone in the {p} can take you down there.
Recipe For Disaster#040.dst: 다음은 [Voidroot]가 필요해요, 공허 깊은 곳에서 나는 아주 희귀한 뿌리죠. {p}에 거기로 데려다줄 사람이 있대요.
Recipe For Disaster#040.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#041.src: Lastly, we need some [Moonsalt], which is famously hard to obtain. Luckily, self-proclaimed 'Space Wizard' Astralaus should have some, so you can just pop over to his tower and ask for some!
Recipe For Disaster#041.dst: 마지막으로 [Moonsalt]가 필요한데, 구하기 어렵기로 유명해요. 다행히 자칭 '우주 마법사' Astralaus가 갖고 있을 테니, 그의 탑에 가서 좀 달라고 하면 돼요!
Recipe For Disaster#041.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#042.src: And that should do it! I'll give you a Recipe Book, just right-click to open it up and track your ingredients. Good luck!
Recipe For Disaster#042.dst: 그럼 다 됐어요! 레시피 북을 드릴게요, 우클릭하면 열려서 재료를 확인할 수 있어요. 행운을 빌어요!
Recipe For Disaster#042.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#043.src: Ugh. Stay out of my way, and we'll get along just fine.
Recipe For Disaster#043.dst: 하. 내 앞길만 막지 마, 그럼 잘 지낼 수 있어.
Recipe For Disaster#043.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#044.src: Make yourself useful and get me everything we need. I'm not in the mood for chit-chat.
Recipe For Disaster#044.dst: 쓸모 있게 굴어서 필요한 거 전부 구해 와. 수다 떨 기분 아니야.
Recipe For Disaster#044.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#045.src: I don't want my reputation tarnished by the likes of you...
Recipe For Disaster#045.dst: 너 같은 녀석 때문에 내 명성에 먹칠하고 싶진 않아...
Recipe For Disaster#045.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#046.src: Listen up, I'm *not* going to say this again. Take notes.
Recipe For Disaster#046.dst: 잘 들어, 두 번은 *안* 말해. 받아 적어.
Recipe For Disaster#046.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#047.src: The key ingredient in my amazing omelette is obviously the [Blue-Ring Grook Egg], which of course you didn't know.
Recipe For Disaster#047.dst: 내 끝내주는 오믈렛의 핵심 재료는 당연히 [Blue-Ring Grook Egg]지. 물론 넌 몰랐겠지만.
Recipe For Disaster#047.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#048.src: Secondly what we need is some [Snail Slime], which is at Snail Island, obviously. Any seasoned chef could tell you that.
Recipe For Disaster#048.dst: 두 번째로 필요한 건 [Snail Slime]이야, 당연히 Snail Island에 있지. 경험 있는 요리사면 다 알아.
Recipe For Disaster#048.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#049.src: Lastly you need a [Talking Mushroom] which is found on the swamp Sky Island, provided you have a functioning sense of sight.
Recipe For Disaster#049.dst: 마지막으로 [Talking Mushroom]이 필요해. 늪지 하늘 섬에 있어, 네 눈이 제대로 달려 있다면 말이지.
Recipe For Disaster#049.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#050.src: YOU FORGOT ALREADY?? I TOLD YOU TO TAKE NOTES!
Recipe For Disaster#050.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#051.src: Lucky for you, at least one of us here is competent. I wrote everything down in this recipe book. Right-click to open it. Now get me my ingredients and scram!
Recipe For Disaster#051.dst: 다행히 여기 한 명은 유능하지. 이 레시피 북에 다 적어 뒀어. 우클릭하면 열려. 이제 재료 구해 와, 얼른 가!
Recipe For Disaster#051.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#052.src: Thrilled to be workin' with you, dude! We'll blow Hamsey's mind.
Recipe For Disaster#052.dst: 너랑 같이 하게 돼서 신난다, 친구! Hamsey 깜짝 놀라게 해 주자.
Recipe For Disaster#052.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#053.src: Hmmm, now what kinda pie should we be bakin', here?
Recipe For Disaster#053.dst: 흐음, 그럼 어떤 파이를 구워 볼까?
Recipe For Disaster#053.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#054.src: Well, I might be a lil' lazy, but when it comes to cookin', I've got the eye. And to me, dude? You look like a real Skyhigh Pie kind of guy! Heheh.
Recipe For Disaster#054.dst: 내가 좀 게으르긴 해도, 요리에 관해선 보는 눈이 있거든. 내가 보기에 넌? 딱 Skyhigh Pie 스타일이야! 헤헤.
Recipe For Disaster#054.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#055.src: Welp, guess you know how to cook up a simple Skyhigh Pie, right? Off you go, I'll be waiting here when you have the ingredients.
Recipe For Disaster#055.dst: 자, 간단한 Skyhigh Pie 만드는 법은 알지? 다녀와, 재료 구하면 여기서 기다리고 있을게.
Recipe For Disaster#055.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#056.src: Hehe, just messin' with you, man! Shoulda seen your face.
Recipe For Disaster#056.dst: 헤헤, 장난이야, 친구! 네 표정 봤어야 했는데.
Recipe For Disaster#056.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#057.src: First, we're gonna need some kinda flour. A lil' [Sunrise Flour] aughtta do.
Recipe For Disaster#057.dst: 먼저 밀가루가 좀 필요해. [Sunrise Flour] 조금이면 될 거야.
Recipe For Disaster#057.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#058.src: A good-sized [Blue-Ring Grook Egg] should give us a lil' kick. Not as much as those grooks'll give you a kick if they see you pilfering their eggs, though!
Recipe For Disaster#058.dst: 큼직한 [Blue-Ring Grook Egg]면 맛에 한 방 더해 줄 거야. 알 훔치다 grook한테 들키면 너한테 날아올 한 방만큼은 아니지만!
Recipe For Disaster#058.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#059.src: Finally, the secret ingredient - A [Skyhigh Raspberry]. Real good stuff, but it's a fair way out. Guess a lil' walking never hurt anyone, huh? Not that I've ever bothered.
Recipe For Disaster#059.dst: 마지막으로 비밀 재료 - [Skyhigh Raspberry]. 진짜 좋은 건데, 좀 멀리 있어. 좀 걷는다고 안 죽잖아? 나야 가 본 적 없지만.
Recipe For Disaster#059.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#060.src: Huh, you've got a bad memory? Yeah, me too, man. Here's a Recipe Book, just right-click to open it up and check where to grab the ingredients!
Recipe For Disaster#060.dst: 어, 기억력이 나쁘다고? 나도 그래, 친구. 여기 레시피 북이야, 우클릭해서 열면 재료 구할 곳이 나와!
Recipe For Disaster#060.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#061.src: Return here once you've got them all. Peace out, dude!
Recipe For Disaster#061.dst: 다 구하면 여기로 와. 그럼 이따 봐, 친구!
Recipe For Disaster#061.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#062.src: Collect [{~} {Ingredient}] at [X, Y, Z] or check your recipe book.
Recipe For Disaster#062.dst: [X, Y, Z]에서 [{~} {Ingredient}]을(를) 모으거나 레시피 북을 확인하세요.

Recipe For Disaster#063.src: Welcome to Astralus' Astral House! Can you get to the top by flipping gravity?
Recipe For Disaster#063.dst: Astralus의 별빛 저택에 온 걸 환영한다! 중력을 뒤집어 꼭대기까지 갈 수 있겠나?
Recipe For Disaster#063.speaker: Astralus

Recipe For Disaster#064.src: Astronomical progress! But this is just the beginning!
Recipe For Disaster#064.dst: 천문학적인 진전이군! 하지만 이건 시작일 뿐이다!
Recipe For Disaster#064.speaker: Astralus

Recipe For Disaster#065.src: ...And why did you come to my tower?
Recipe For Disaster#065.speaker: Astralus

Recipe For Disaster#066.src: My Moonsalt? How absurd! I collected mine myself, you collect yours! It's only fair.
Recipe For Disaster#066.dst: 내 Moonsalt? 터무니없군! 내 건 내가 직접 모았으니 네 건 네가 모아! 그게 공평하지.
Recipe For Disaster#066.speaker: Astralus

Recipe For Disaster#067.src: Darn humans, you never listen! I said... Get. It. Yourself.
Recipe For Disaster#067.dst: 빌어먹을 인간들, 도통 말을 안 들어! 말했잖나... 직. 접. 구. 해.
Recipe For Disaster#067.speaker: Astralus

Recipe For Disaster#068.src: What takes you here, strangeling? What namings do you have? Hu-man? We claim Humyn! Bad choose, pick elsewhere strangeling!
Recipe For Disaster#068.dst: 여기 왜 오심, 낯선이? 무슨 이름함 가짐? 휴-먼? 우리는 휴민 주장함! 나쁜 고름, 딴 데서 골라, 낯선이!
Recipe For Disaster#068.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#069.src: Investigating for helping? How many conveniences! Humyns requires assistancing! You observers, humyns failflies into large crater-rock!
Recipe For Disaster#069.dst: 도움 위해 조사함? 얼마나 많은 편리함! 휴민 도움함 필요함! 너 관찰자, 휴민 큰 구덩이바위로 추락실패함!
Recipe For Disaster#069.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#070.src: Burnmilk run out and one direction to retrieve it is moonsalt! We strike lucknugget and discover moonsalt on crater-rock!
Recipe For Disaster#070.dst: 불우유 떨어짐, 되찾는 한 방향은 moonsalt! 우리 행운덩이 쳐서 구덩이바위에서 moonsalt 발견함!
Recipe For Disaster#070.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#071.src: Refined moonsalt gives burnmilk for spacezoom! Inconveniencing, spacezoom destroyed. Humyns create miniscule Spacezoom!
Recipe For Disaster#071.dst: 정제 moonsalt는 우주쓩에 불우유 줌! 불편하게도, 우주쓩 부서짐. 휴민 아주작은 우주쓩 만듦!
Recipe For Disaster#071.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#072.src: Only singular humyn can fit in current spacezoom. If strangeling helps humyns will let strangeling in spacezoom. Humyns can create new spacezoom in given time!
Recipe For Disaster#072.dst: 지금 우주쓩엔 단수 휴민만 들어감. 낯선이 도우면 휴민이 낯선이 우주쓩에 태워 줌. 휴민 주어진 시간에 새 우주쓩 만들 수 있음!
Recipe For Disaster#072.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#073.src: Humyns currently residing on crater-rock, meaning waiting is not result of death!
Recipe For Disaster#073.dst: 휴민 현재 구덩이바위 거주함, 기다림은 죽음의 결과 아님 뜻함!
Recipe For Disaster#073.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#074.src: Moonsalt discovered in saltcave in north, strangeling follow path!
Recipe For Disaster#074.dst: Moonsalt 북쪽 소금동굴에서 발견함, 낯선이 길 따라감!
Recipe For Disaster#074.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#075.src: Just [{~} Unrefined Moonsalt] need for burnmilk, strangeling can grab any left over!
Recipe For Disaster#075.dst: 불우유엔 [{~} Unrefined Moonsalt]만 필요함, 남은 건 낯선이 가져가도 됨!
Recipe For Disaster#075.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#076.src: When strangeling has moonsalt, refine at device beside humyn and go zoom in spacezoom!
Recipe For Disaster#076.dst: 낯선이 moonsalt 가지면, 휴민 옆 장치에서 정제하고 우주쓩 타고 쓩 감!
Recipe For Disaster#076.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#077.src: Hello aaand welcome to the Racetrack of the Century!
Recipe For Disaster#077.dst: 안녕하세요오오, 세기의 경주장에 오신 걸 환영합니다!
Recipe For Disaster#077.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#078.src: One winner, one loser. And Usnail Bolt eats losers for breakfast.
Recipe For Disaster#078.dst: 승자 하나, 패자 하나. 그리고 Usnail Bolt는 패자를 아침으로 먹죠.
Recipe For Disaster#078.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#079.src: Breakfast? Wait, did I have breakfast? A little breckkie could be good fo-
Recipe For Disaster#079.dst: 아침? 잠깐, 나 아침 먹었나? 간단히 아침 좀 먹으면 좋을 텐-
Recipe For Disaster#079.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#080.src: Well, no matter. What do you say, adventurer? Enter the race against Usnail Bolt. The grand prize is some Snail Slime!
Recipe For Disaster#080.dst: 뭐, 상관없죠. 어때요, 모험가님? Usnail Bolt와 경주해 보세요. 1등 상품은 Snail Slime이에요!
Recipe For Disaster#080.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#082.src: Shame, could've been a great race. See you around, adventurer!
Recipe For Disaster#082.dst: 아쉽네요, 멋진 경주가 될 수 있었는데. 또 봐요, 모험가님!
Recipe For Disaster#082.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#083.src: Well well well... looks like Usnail Bolt has won this one. Again.
Recipe For Disaster#083.dst: 이런 이런 이런... Usnail Bolt가 이겼군요. 또요.
Recipe For Disaster#083.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#084.src: Not your lucky day, human. Oh well, you know the price for losing. Guards!
Recipe For Disaster#084.dst: 운이 없는 날이네요, 인간. 뭐, 지면 어떻게 되는지 알죠. 경비병!
Recipe For Disaster#084.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#085.src: Wowee! In what turned out to be an amazing race, the human has managed to steal the lead right out from Usnail Bolt's nose!
Recipe For Disaster#085.dst: 와우! 놀라운 경주 끝에, 인간이 Usnail Bolt의 코앞에서 선두를 가로챘습니다!
Recipe For Disaster#085.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#086.src: Here, human. Take this slime as your prize.
Recipe For Disaster#086.dst: 자, 인간. 상품으로 이 점액을 받아요.
Recipe For Disaster#086.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#087.src: ISN'T THIS JUST ABSOLUTELY FANTASTIC. A HUMAN?! WHO WOULD HAVE GUESSED.
Recipe For Disaster#087.dst: 이거 정말 끝내주게 환상적이네. 인간?! 누가 알았겠어.
Recipe For Disaster#087.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#088.src: YOU'RE THE SEVENTH ONE PASSING ME TODAY AND YOU'RE NO DIFFERENT FROM THE OTHERS.
Recipe For Disaster#088.dst: 오늘 날 지나간 게 네가 일곱 번째인데, 다른 놈들이랑 다를 게 하나도 없네.
Recipe For Disaster#088.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#089.src: EVERY SINGLE ONE WITH THAT DOPEY SHEEPISH LOOK ON THEIR FACE, AS IF A TALKING MUSHROOM IS OUT OF THE BLUE.
Recipe For Disaster#089.dst: 하나같이 멍청하고 머쓱한 얼굴로, 말하는 버섯이 무슨 날벼락이라도 되는 것처럼 쳐다보지.
Recipe For Disaster#089.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#090.src: GIVE ME A BREAK, I'VE HAD ENOUGH OF JERKS PICKING ME UP AND DISRESPECTING ME LIKE THAT. PRIVATE SPACE, EVER HEARD OF IT?
Recipe For Disaster#090.dst: 좀 봐줘, 날 뽑아 들고 그렇게 무시하는 녀석들한테 질렸어. 사생활이라고, 들어는 봤어?
Recipe For Disaster#090.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#091.src: WHY DO I EVEN TRY. JUST LOOK AT YOU! THE EPITOME OF CLUELESS. WHAT NOW, GONNA TAKE ME ON SOME LOONEY ADVENTURE ACROSS THE SKY ISLANDS?
Recipe For Disaster#091.dst: 내가 뭘 기대하겠어. 너 좀 봐! 눈치 없음의 결정체네. 이번엔 뭐, 하늘 섬들을 누비는 황당한 모험에라도 끌고 가게?
Recipe For Disaster#091.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#092.src: I HOPE NOT, IF YOU WERE THINKING THAT. I'VE ALREADY LOST A STEM TODAY BECAUSE SOME DIMWIT TRIED TAKING A BITE OUT OF ME... LIVE!
Recipe For Disaster#092.dst: 그 생각이었다면 제발 아니길. 오늘 어떤 멍청이가 날 한입 베어 물려고 해서 줄기를 벌써 하나 잃었거든... 산 채로!
Recipe For Disaster#092.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#093.src: DON'T TELL ME, ARE YOU TAKING ME ON SOME LOONEY ADVENTURE ACROSS THE SKY ISLANDS? HOW LOVELY.
Recipe For Disaster#093.dst: 설마, 날 하늘 섬들을 누비는 황당한 모험에 끌고 가는 거야? 참 좋기도 하겠다.
Recipe For Disaster#093.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#094.src: A KITCHEN YOU SAY, WELL, IF IT'LL PUT ME OUT OF MY MISERY AS SOON AS POSSIBLE, THEN WHY NOT.
Recipe For Disaster#094.dst: 주방이라고, 뭐, 이 비참함을 빨리 끝내 준다면야, 안 될 거 없지.
Recipe For Disaster#094.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#095.src: WAIT, WHY ARE YOU STUFFING ME INTO YOUR BAG? HOW DO YOU EXPECT ME TO BREATHE IN HERE?!
Recipe For Disaster#095.dst: 잠깐, 왜 날 가방에 쑤셔 넣는 건데? 이 안에서 숨을 어떻게 쉬라고?!
Recipe For Disaster#095.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#096.src: Hello there! I can see you knead you some sunrise flour, don't you?
Recipe For Disaster#096.dst: 안녕하세요! 해돋이 밀가루가 필요하시군요, 척 보면 빵 알죠!
Recipe For Disaster#096.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#097.src: It's needed rye away? Well no worries, friend!
Recipe For Disaster#097.dst: 빵리 필요하다고요? 걱정 마세요, 친구! 제가 반죽해 드리죠!
Recipe For Disaster#097.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#098.src: Well butter me up and call me toast, it seems I ran out of the stuff, there's none left.
Recipe For Disaster#098.dst: 이런, 빵 터질 노릇이네, 밀가루가 다 떨어져서 하나도 없어요.
Recipe For Disaster#098.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#099.src: I'm sorry if I see to just be loafing around, but at yeast I know how to make some more.
Recipe For Disaster#099.dst: 빈둥빵둥 노는 것처럼 보였다면 미안해요, 그래도 더 만드는 법은 제가 알죠.
Recipe For Disaster#099.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#100.src: Can you see that wheat field over there, next to the bakery? You can farm up some wheat and pop it on the mill.
Recipe For Disaster#100.dst: 빵집 옆에 저 밀밭 보이죠? 거기서 밀을 수확해서 방앗간에 넣으면 돼요.
Recipe For Disaster#100.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#101.src: Grab a scythe from the tool merchant next dough and get to work!
Recipe For Disaster#101.dst: 빵집 옆집 도구 상인에게 낫을 받아서 일을 시작하세요!
Recipe For Disaster#101.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#102.src: Make as much as you want, I've made all the bread I need for today already.
Recipe For Disaster#102.dst: 원하는 만큼 만드세요, 오늘 필요한 빵은 벌써 다 구웠거든요.
Recipe For Disaster#102.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#103.src: Howdy, pal! Looking for some Skyhigh Raspberries? They work great in a pie!
Recipe For Disaster#103.dst: 안녕, 친구! Skyhigh Raspberry 찾아요? 파이에 넣으면 최고예요!
Recipe For Disaster#103.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#104.src: If you're interested, it's just a small fee of {~} Emeralds to get access to the island.
Recipe For Disaster#104.dst: 관심 있으면, 섬에 들어가는 데 {~} 에메랄드만 내면 돼요.
Recipe For Disaster#104.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#105.src: A man's gotta make a living somehow, so I've set up a system of cannons to take you right up to the island they grow on!
Recipe For Disaster#105.dst: 먹고살아야 하니까, 산딸기가 자라는 섬까지 바로 보내 주는 대포 시스템을 만들었죠!
Recipe For Disaster#105.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#106.src: So, whaddya say? Small price for a little adventure, and as many raspberries as you can eat!
Recipe For Disaster#106.dst: 그래서, 어때요? 작은 모험에 소소한 값, 산딸기는 먹고 싶은 만큼!
Recipe For Disaster#106.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#107.src: Alrighty! Just head on over to that island beside me and jump in the cannon - it's perfectly safe, I promise!
Recipe For Disaster#107.dst: 좋아요! 제 옆 섬으로 가서 대포에 뛰어드세요 - 완전 안전해요, 약속해요!
Recipe For Disaster#107.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#108.src: Find your way up the island and grab as many raspberries as you want! When you're done just jump in the big cannon and come back to shore!
Recipe For Disaster#108.dst: 섬 위로 올라가서 산딸기를 원하는 만큼 따세요! 다 따면 큰 대포에 뛰어들어 해안으로 돌아오면 돼요!
Recipe For Disaster#108.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#109.src: Alrighty, no worries. Feel free to come back if you're ever in the mood for some!
Recipe For Disaster#109.dst: 좋아요, 괜찮아요. 먹고 싶어지면 언제든 다시 와요!
Recipe For Disaster#109.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#110.src: Present the ingredients to your chosen chef.

Recipe For Disaster#111.src: Have you got all the ingredients? Amazing!
Recipe For Disaster#111.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#112.src: Okay you set back and let me work on the cooking, just pass over the ingredients!
Recipe For Disaster#112.dst: 좋아요, 뒤로 물러서서 요리는 저한테 맡기세요, 재료만 넘겨주면 돼요!
Recipe For Disaster#112.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#113.src: Aha! That should do it! Hopefully I've done everything correctly... but wow, would you look at the color of that soup!
Recipe For Disaster#113.dst: 아하! 이러면 됐어요! 다 제대로 했으면 좋겠는데... 그런데 와, 이 수프 색깔 좀 봐요!
Recipe For Disaster#113.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#114.src: You should bring it over to Hamsey to see what he thinks!
Recipe For Disaster#114.dst: 이거 Hamsey한테 가져가서 어떻게 생각하는지 들어 봐요!
Recipe For Disaster#114.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#115.src: You got everything? Took you long enough.
Recipe For Disaster#115.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#116.src: Let's get started. Everyone else already finished. Stay back while I work my magic.
Recipe For Disaster#116.dst: 시작하자. 다른 사람들은 벌써 끝냈어. 내가 솜씨 부리는 동안 물러나 있어.
Recipe For Disaster#116.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#117.src: Mwah! My masterdish is finished. Present this to the chef, I'm sure he'll love it!
Recipe For Disaster#117.dst: 쪽! 내 걸작 요리 완성이다. 이거 셰프한테 가져가, 분명 좋아할 거야!
Recipe For Disaster#117.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#118.src: And be CAREFUL taking it over. That food could be worth HUNDREDS once I'm famous!
Recipe For Disaster#118.dst: 그리고 '조심해서' 가져가. 내가 유명해지면 이 요리는 '수백'은 나갈 거라고!
Recipe For Disaster#118.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#119.src: You got everything? Awesome stuff, dude.
Recipe For Disaster#119.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#120.src: I'll just take a smallll bit of this raspberry - chef's commission, eh? And let's get started!
Recipe For Disaster#120.dst: 이 산딸기 조오금만 먹을게 - 요리사 수수료 알지? 그럼 시작하자!
Recipe For Disaster#120.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#121.src: And we're all done. Hamsey's gonna love this.
Recipe For Disaster#121.dst: 다 됐다. Hamsey가 엄청 좋아할 거야.
Recipe For Disaster#121.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#122.src: Here you go, dawg. Pleasure working with you - show this to Hamsey and we'll see what he thinks. Make sure you don't "lose" any of it on the way over - you know what they say about your own supply!
Recipe For Disaster#122.dst: 여기 있어, 친구. 같이 해서 즐거웠어 - Hamsey한테 보여 주고 뭐라는지 보자. 가는 길에 조금이라도 "잃어버리면" 안 된다 - 자기 물건 손대면 어떻게 되는지 알지!
Recipe For Disaster#122.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#123.src: Talk to Hamsey with your finished dish.

Recipe For Disaster#124.src: Ah, you have finished your dish? Well, then, il est temps de goûter!
Recipe For Disaster#124.dst: Ah, 요리를 완성했나요? 그럼, il est temps de goûter!
Recipe For Disaster#124.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#125.src: Let us retreat to my private dining room... this way!
Recipe For Disaster#125.dst: 제 전용 식당으로 자리를 옮기죠... 이쪽이에요!
Recipe For Disaster#125.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#126.src: Meet Hamsey in the dining room at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recipe For Disaster#127.src: Welcome back, mon ami! I see you've return with a dish in hand!
Recipe For Disaster#127.dst: 어서 와요, mon ami! 요리를 들고 돌아왔군요!
Recipe For Disaster#127.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#128.src: A stew? Seems simple, but even the simplest things in life can be le meilleur!
Recipe For Disaster#128.dst: 스튜? 단순해 보이지만, 인생에서 가장 단순한 것도 le meilleur일 수 있죠!
Recipe For Disaster#128.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#129.src: Adventurer, are you sure you made this dish? It is so good I might as well close the restaurant!
Recipe For Disaster#129.dst: 모험가님, 정말 이걸 직접 만들었어요? 너무 맛있어서 레스토랑 문을 닫아야겠어요!
Recipe For Disaster#129.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#130.src: You never fail to surprise me, friend. Here, take this apron, an essential of any true chef.
Recipe For Disaster#130.dst: 늘 저를 놀라게 하는군요, 친구. 자, 이 앞치마를 받아요, 진정한 요리사의 필수품이죠.
Recipe For Disaster#130.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#131.src: I cannot help but notice that your dish is ready!
Recipe For Disaster#131.dst: 요리가 준비된 게 눈에 띄지 않을 수가 없군요!
Recipe For Disaster#131.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#132.src: Let me taste your dish and I will present you mine! Mon dieu, une omelette?
Recipe For Disaster#132.dst: 당신 요리를 맛보고 제 요리를 보여 드리죠! Mon dieu, une omelette?
Recipe For Disaster#132.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#133.src: Je suis déçu, ami. I would prefer biting into a mule derrière! This thing... a Gert wouldn't touch it!
Recipe For Disaster#133.dst: Je suis déçu, ami. 차라리 노새 derrière를 깨물겠어요! 이건... Gert도 안 먹겠어요!
Recipe For Disaster#133.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#134.src: I see you haven't improved in the art of cuisine. Leave me be, and come back when you have learned what good food is!
Recipe For Disaster#134.dst: 요리 실력은 전혀 늘지 않았군요. 날 내버려 두고, 좋은 음식이 뭔지 알게 되면 돌아와요!
Recipe For Disaster#134.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#135.src: I see you've returned, and not empty handed. Please, show me what you've created!
Recipe For Disaster#135.dst: 돌아왔군요, 빈손도 아니고요. 자, 무엇을 만들었는지 보여 줘요!
Recipe For Disaster#135.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#136.src: A pie? Why, you must have been helped by Frank. He always has a thing for making pie!
Recipe For Disaster#136.dst: 파이? 이런, Frank가 도와줬군요. 그 친구는 파이 만드는 걸 좋아하거든요!
Recipe For Disaster#136.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#137.src: I can see that your compétences culinaires are very well developed!
Recipe For Disaster#137.dst: 당신의 compétences culinaires가 아주 잘 발달했군요!
Recipe For Disaster#137.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#138.src: Though I will not truly call you a chef quite yet, you are très bien! Have this reward as congratulations!
Recipe For Disaster#138.dst: 아직 진정한 요리사라고 부를 순 없지만, 당신은 très bien! 축하의 의미로 이 보상을 받아요!
Recipe For Disaster#138.speaker: Chef Hamsey
